name: ∞-topos Giraud Axioms Constraint via cvc5
description: cvc5 SMT proof of ∞-topos universal colimit + disjoint coproduct constraints

test_positive_valid_infinity_topos.description: cvc5 SAT: ∞-topos with universal colimits AND disjoint coproducts is valid

test_positive_giraud_generator.description: cvc5 SAT: Giraud axiom 3 - generator object exists in ∞-topos

test_positive_effective_epi_topology.description: cvc5 SAT: Giraud axiom 4 - effective epis form Grothendieck topology

test_negative_non_universal_colimits.description: cvc5 UNSAT: non-universal colimits violate Giraud axiom

test_negative_overlapping_coproducts.description: cvc5 UNSAT: overlapping coproducts violate Giraud disjointness axiom

test_negative_no_generator.description: cvc5 UNSAT: absence of generator violates Giraud axiom 3

test_boundary_finite_topos.description: cvc5 SAT: finite ∞-topos with bounded objects

test_boundary_symbolic_giraud_axioms.description: sympy: symbolic encoding of Giraud axiom schema
test_boundary_symbolic_giraud_axioms.axiom_1: ∀X ∈ Obj(C): colimits over X exist and pullback-stable
test_boundary_symbolic_giraud_axioms.axiom_2: ∀{X_i}: coproducts ∐ X_i have disjoint summands (pullback zero)
